summary: Iteration 5 — Offline sync scalability + conflict resolution + Owner pill-tabs. Backend: 10 passed / 2 skipped on test_iter5_offline_sync.py (customers idempotency verified end-to-end; sales + collections idempotency SKIPPED only because the agent seed lacks inventory/debtor to exercise the full path — the Convex handlers use the same `docOrgUnique(..., id, org_id)` early-return pattern as customers, verified by code review of sales.ts:63-66, collections.ts:51-54). /api/auth/me returns 200 for all 4 seeded tokens with correct role (role=DEVELOPER/OWNER on dev/owner, employee_type=ACCOUNTANT/FIELD_AGENT on acct/agent). /api/stats/overview (has today_sales/sales_total/collections_total/debts_total), /api/products, /api/customers, /api/sales for OWNER all 200. No plaintext DEVELOPER_PHONES anywhere in /app/frontend/{convex,src,app} (only DEVELOPER_PHONES_HASH). Frontend: owner /owner renders dark-navy Header with 3 pill tabs 'الرئيسية' / 'التنبيهات' / 'الأداء' (testIDs header-tab-home/-alerts/-performance), all tappable, body swaps correctly: home → stats + recent sales (stat-today-sales present), alerts → AlertsCard + StaleDebtors + low-stock, performance → ProLock(SalesTargets + Leaderboard). Agent /owner (routed to /dist) correctly shows NO pill tabs (header-tab-* all absent) — single-scroll preserved with LocationCard. Offline queue scalability: seeded 1200 synthetic items into localStorage[offline_queue] → SyncBanner immediately showed 'جارِ المزامنة · 0/1200 (0%)' confirming progress.total matches backlog size, parallelism active (bounded concurrency 6 drains across 4 distinct fake paths). Seeded 20 items with fake paths → queue fully drained in <8s to 0, failed tray populated with 20 entries, Arabic error 'غير موجود' preserved (404→permanent classifier, no retry attempts, attempts=0). Seeded 5 failed items → tapping sync-banner opened the sync Sheet (testID sync-sheet) with per-item rows (testID failed-item-<id>), each exposing NEW 'إعادة' pill (testID retry-failed-<id>) + 'تجاهل' pill (testID discard-failed-<id>); sync-now-button ('مزامنة الآن') present in footer. Zero console errors on all 3 scenarios. Code review of offline.ts confirms: (a) 409 → dropOptimistic filters cached array by id, invalidateQueries([path]), removes from queue, NO entry added to failed tray (lines 194-200); (b) 503/transient → attempts++, next_attempt_at=now+backoff(attempt-1) (~1s..16s jittered), stays in queue; after MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 → moved to failed tray with Arabic message (lines 201-212); (c) api.ts uses AbortController with configurable timeoutMs (default 25000) and tags aborts as offline:true so sync loop pauses rather than consuming an attempt (api.ts:18-35); (d) per-path serialization via inFlightPaths Set keeps same-path writes in insertion order while different paths flush in parallel (offline.ts:238-246).
critical_code_review_comments: offline.ts syncQueue() correctly implements bounded-concurrency per-path serialization: each round builds a batch of up to PARALLEL=6 items where no two share a `path` (inFlightPaths Set), preserving ordering for dependent writes against the same endpoint while fanning out across endpoints — scalable to thousands of pending items. Rounds hard-capped at 200 to defend against pathological retry loops. (/app/frontend/src/offline.ts:236-272)

offline.ts conflict path (409): dropOptimistic() iterates the cache index, filters any array that contains a row whose id matches, writes back AND calls queryClient.setQueryData so React Query picks up the change immediately; then invalidateQueries([path]) triggers a refetch. The 409 item is removed from the queue but NOT appended to failed — correct, since the server is authoritative and nothing is user-actionable. (/app/frontend/src/offline.ts:162-200)

offline.ts classifier buckets exactly match spec: offline (e.offline), conflict (409), transient (429 / 5xx / timeout-like messages with no status), permanent (everything else). Timeout/abort fall through to transient so a hiccup during a huge flush retries up to MAX_ATTEMPTS=5. (/app/frontend/src/offline.ts:137-147)

api.ts per-request AbortController with timeoutMs (default 25000); aborts are rethrown as `{offline:true}` so classifyError returns 'offline' and the sync loop pauses rather than burning an attempt — correct safeguard against a hung connection stalling the entire backlog. (/app/frontend/src/api.ts:18-35)

sales.ts, collections.ts, customers.ts all honor the body `id` idempotency contract: if `id` is provided and a doc with that id already exists in the same org, return the existing doc without inserting a new row. The pattern is identical across the 3 files (docOrgUnique for sales/collections, by_biz_id index + unique() for customers). Customers verified end-to-end at runtime; sales/collections verified by code review (not exercisable due to agent seed limitations).

src/ui.tsx Header renders optional pill-tabs inside the dark-navy area with testIDs `header-tab-${key}` — exactly as spec'd for the Chats/Status/Calls-style switch (/app/frontend/src/ui.tsx:220-337). Overview.tsx wires 3 tabs for owner/accountant and ZERO tabs for agent (useTabs = !isAgent) — matches spec. (/app/frontend/src/screens/Overview.tsx:42-49)

SyncBanner shows per-item 'إعادة' (retry) + 'تجاهل' (discard) pills for every failed item, with distinct testIDs retry-failed-<id> and discard-failed-<id>. Progress line 'جارِ المزامنة · done/total (pct%)' + horizontal progress bar (testID sync-progress-bar) render whenever progress.total>0. (/app/frontend/src/components/SyncBanner.tsx:60-69, 42-44)
